summary.text: In a personal post on February 22, 2024, Selway tentatively described AI as more novel and dangerous than crypto, particularly when used deliberately to undermine accumulated human knowledge. On February 11, 2023, he argued that machine learning's results in quantitative investing did not bode well for an AI “truth model,” citing the messiness of markets and life.
